samples.title: A new item arrives
samples.prompt: I just acquired ten cartons of Maggi. Add them to my inventory.
samples.context: Maggi is a new item. The pack size is unknown.
samples.expected: Ask how many packs are in one carton. Save nothing.

samples.title: Answer the pack-size question
samples.prompt: Each carton contains twenty four packs.
samples.context: You just received 10 cartons of Maggi. Saathi is waiting for the pack size.

samples.title: More of an existing item
samples.prompt: I bought five more boxes of KitKat. Add them to the existing stock.
samples.context: KitKat already has 5 boxes in stock.
samples.expected: Review 5 + 5 = 10 boxes. Preserve the saved price.

samples.title: Receive stock in Hindi
samples.prompt: चाय के दो पैकेट और आए हैं। इन्हें स्टॉक में जोड़ दो।
samples.context: Tea is tracked in packs. There are 18 packs in stock.

samples.title: Correct the total count
samples.prompt: I counted all the rice. Set the total rice stock to twenty kilograms.
samples.context: Rice currently has 45 kg in stock.
samples.expected: Set the total to 20 kg; do not add another 20 kg.
